items.title: RI1FJL: 80 m tonight, 8–9 days left, Europe is down
items.blurb: Vasily R7AL, 1030Z: team is well, still QRV, antennas up. 80 m tonight. Few ops, huge pileups, not every band and mode. Europe was booming yesterday and is poor today. Weather fine with a strong breeze. About 8–9 more days on Heiss Island, then a pack-up day.

items.title: ZK3ZL Tokelau slipped to November 2027
items.blurb: Perseverance DX Group missed the return-ferry booking. Call and outbound Nov 17 ferry were issued; the inbound seats went to other passengers. No cheap backup. Gear from DX Engineering stays packed. Donors who want money back: refund@pdxg.net. Otherwise it sits in escrow for 2027.

items.title: HAARP on 2.8–10 MHz through 27 August
items.blurb: UAF HAARP research campaign 25–27 August UTC, 2.8–10 MHz. Tonight 2000–2400Z, then 0000–0400Z on the 27th. Times move with the ionosphere. Reception reports to haarp.gi.alaska.edu. Ionograms at the diagnostic suite.

items.title: POTA board: French ZNIEFF zones are not parks; old QSOs stay
items.blurb: Board statement 16 August: ZNIEFF is an ecological inventory, not a qualifying park. Ineligible references will be deactivated. QSOs already logged stay credited; nothing new after deactivation. The 85% France wipe circulating this week is not accurate, the board says. Mapping rep Larry resigned; he was not removed.

items.title: V5/HB9BFM Namibia, 26 August–20 September, mostly Olivia
items.blurb: Hanspeter HB9BFM is V5/HB9BFM from several Namibia QTHs starting today through 20 September. Mostly 1600–1900Z on Olivia 8/250, 14072.000 kHz center. Sometimes 20 m VarAC.

items.title: ISS amateur radios back after Tuesday’s USOS EVA
items.blurb: ARISS schedule: Columbus and Service Module radios powered down 24 August for a 25 August USOS EVA, then up again 1320Z and 1325Z today. Crossband repeater stays 145.990 up (PL 67) / 437.800 down. Next school contact: Rockingham Scout Group, Western Australia, 29 August 0856Z via NA1SS.
